ideas.title: The Impact of Welfare Fraud on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of welfare fraud on vulnerable populations, including low-income families and children.
ideas.angle: The human impact of welfare fraud
questions: What are the consequences of welfare fraud on vulnerable populations?
How can we prevent welfare fraud while still supporting those in need?
ideas.insight: This story would require a deep dive into the data and statistics surrounding welfare fraud, as well as interviews with experts and individuals affected by the issue.
